It is, unfortunately, the sort of decision all warriors must make.|[[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]] and [[Maris Ferasi]]|<ref name="OBF">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref>}}
'''Living shields''', also known as '''slave shields''', were protective shields used by the [[Vagaari Empire]], the [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]] [[Species/Legends|species']] to discourage counterattacks and force an enemy to cease fire, allowing them to return a massive siege of blasterfire.<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref> The Vagaari employed [[zero-g plastic bubble]]s on their [[Vagaari slaver fleet|fleet's]] [[Hull/Legends|hulls]] as living shields, which contained a [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] or [[Slavery/Legends|slave]]<ref name="OBF" /> whose screams and cries were broadcast in public [[Comm unit/Legends|comm]] frequencies.<ref name="TUR" /> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jorus C'baoth]] considered the Vagaari an &quot;evil&quot; group after he saw the living shields on their [[Warship/Legends|warships']] hulls.<ref name="OBF" />
